exercises.title: COTS selection 1 — which selection aspect?
exercises.problemHtml:
Five aspects feed COTS selection: user requirements (use cases, stories — not detailed functional specs), business rules (can the package be configured to comply?), data needs (major disconnects with the vendor’s data model), quality requirements (performance, usability, modifiability, interoperability, security…), and evaluating solutions. Which aspect does each selection question belong to?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Năm khía cạnh khi chọn gói phần mềm có sẵn.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: COTS selection 2 — the weighted evaluation
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers (after Lawlis et al.): 1. weight each requirement 1–10 by importance; 2. rate each package’s satisfaction of each requirement: 1 = fully, 0.5 = partially, 0 = not at all; 3. score = Σ weight × rating; 4. compare. Write function evaluate(requirements, ratings) returning the packages sorted by score (highest first, ties by name) as [{ name, score, pct }] where pct = score ÷ maximum possible score × 100, rounded to 1 decimal. A missing rating counts as 0; a rating other than 0, 0.5 or 1 makes the whole package invalid — leave it out. Then set WINNER for the sample.

Requirements

  • Maximum score = Σ weights.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Phương pháp có trọng số: trọng số 1–10, mức đáp ứng 1/0,5/0, điểm = Σ trọng số × mức; xếp hạng, % so với tối đa; mức không hợp lệ ⇒ loại gói.

Yêu cầu

  • Điểm tối đa = tổng trọng số.
hintsJson: Kiểm mức ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}; sai ⇒ bỏ cả gói.

exercises.title: COTS selection 3 — requirements at the right level
exercises.problemHtml:
Focus COTS acquisition requirements at the user-requirement level: there is little point specifying detailed functional requirements or designing a UI, since the vendor already did that. Evaluate business rules that matter most, look for real data-model disconnects (not just different names), and explore quality attributes.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# COTS selection 3 — requirements at the right level — answer key

1. Before buying a package, should you design the screens in detail?Trước khi mua gói, có nên thiết kế màn hình chi tiết?
   Answer: a) No — specify user requirements and evaluate how the package supports them
   The vendor already designed the UI.VI: Nhà cung cấp đã thiết kế giao diện.

2. The vendor calls patients "contacts". Is this a data disconnect?Nhà cung cấp gọi bệnh nhân là "contacts". Đây có phải lệch dữ liệu?
   Answer: a) Not necessarily — look for real structural gaps, not merely different names
   Names differ; structure matters.VI: Tên khác không quan trọng bằng cấu trúc.

exercises.problemHtml:
Too many candidates ⇒ a short list of key criteria to narrow down. Too many criteria ⇒ use the business objectives to pick the most important. Vendor misrepresentation and demos that look great ⇒ ask the vendor to walk through your actual use cases.
